channel.title: Tutorials | Marco Troisi
channel.description: Marco Troisi is a founder, fractional CTO and software architect. Through O2A Labs he helps founders make sound technical decisions and build software that serves the business.

item.title: How to use Fat Free framework from the command line
item.description: A simple tutorial that will enable you to use Fat Free framework from command line in just a few minutes.

item.title: Make your website available offline with HTML5
item.description: One of the really cool things HTML5 allows to do is to make our web apps available even when our visitors are not connected to any network (assuming, obviously, that they have visited the website before, under network coverage).

item.title: How to set up a full web server on a Raspberry PI
item.description: In this post I am going to show you how to set up a fully operative web server on Raspberry PI. More specifically, this a LAMP server, which means Linux+Apache+MySQL+PHP, which the most common combination you find in most of the servers worldwide.

item.title: I got a Rasperry PI!
item.description: Yes, I’ve got it! After more or less 3 weeks of waiting, I can finally put my hands on my new, shiny Raspberry PI! And I have to say I had lose any hope to get it before 2013, but, unexpectedly, it got to my house just a few hours before 2012 came to the end.

item.title: Yii: XML generator
item.description: As I needed to create some custom XMLs for a project I am working on, I have created an Yii extension based on a nice class being developed by Simon Willison. Using this extension, everyone will be easily able to generate an XML. I am pretty sure there may be different and even more powerful …
